intro: Eight articles on financial fraud published between 12 April and 7 October 2026 examine activity tied to Tren de Aragua and NGate. The coverage spans financial services, banking, entertainment, financial-services, and the general public. The United States, Latin America, Venezuela, Brazil, and Mexico appear among the affected regions. Four articles carry high severity and two carry medium severity. The reporting documents how fraud campaigns reach both institutions and individuals across these markets, with the two named threat actors each featuring separately in the archive.
